title: Generic Schema for Two Boolean Questions

answers.description: An array of 2 boolean answers, one for each question asked, in the order the questions were asked.

category.description: Category of the finding: 'AG' (geringfügige Abweichung), 'AS' (schwerwiegende Abweichung), 'E' (Empfehlung), or 'OK' when nothing deviates.

description.description: A clear, concise description of the finding in German, including evidence and the document reference; a brief confirmation when the category is 'OK'.

finding.description: A single, structured finding for this section.
